title: 英伟达财报亮眼却难撼市场，分析师称“不够惊艳”
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jay, what was your initial thoughts here, particularly with that $108 billion guidance for the current quarter?
segments.zh: 杰，你最初的想法是什么，特别是当前季度1080亿美元的指引？

segments.en: I think my initial impression is that's a really impressive quarter and nobody's going to care.
segments.zh: 我觉得我最初的印象是，这确实是个令人印象深刻的季度，但没人会在意。

segments.en: Yeah, not impressive enough, I guess? Yeah, I mean, not impressive enough but it gets to this idea and I think I asked this question of a lot of our guests leading up to this is what can Jensen Wong and company actually say that does
segments.zh: 是的，不够令人印象深刻，对吧？是的，我的意思是，不够令人印象深刻，但这引出了一个问题，我在之前问过很多嘉宾，黄仁勋和公司到底能说什么来打动这个市场？

segments.en: impress this market? It's not in the earnings release but maybe it comes on the conference call?
segments.zh: 财报里没有，但也许电话会议上会有？

segments.en: Jensen is a master orator. He typically can get a few points up after hours just by through pure magnetism. His track record on that hasn't been so great the last couple quarters
segments.zh: 黄仁勋是演讲大师。他通常能靠个人魅力让股价盘后上涨几个点。但过去几个季度他的这个记录并不太好。

segments.en: but he's a very good public speaker he can be very persuasive and so I think people know that and so we're going to be reading second and third derivatives of every word he says
segments.zh: 但他是个很好的公众演说家，很有说服力，所以我认为人们知道这一点，我们会仔细解读他说的每一个字的弦外之音。

segments.en: and interpreting his tone and his bearing to see what his real mood is see if we can infer what his real mood is but I think you know as much as I'm sort of negative on the stock I'm sympathetic
segments.zh: 并解读他的语气和举止，看看他真实的心情，试图推断他的真实情绪。但我想，尽管我对这只权益资产持负面看法，我还是同情他们。

segments.en: to them they're they're putting up impressive numbers and it's just very hard for the stock to get ahead and I think that speaks to a lot of things you've just been talking about for the last few
segments.zh: 他们交出了令人瞩目的数字，但股价很难上涨，这说明了你们过去几分钟一直在讨论的很多问题。

segments.en: minutes they're sold out and where do you get upside when you're sold out? That's not going to change this year and so for the time being it's going to be very hard for them to impress anybody
segments.zh: 他们产品售罄，售罄了还能有什么上涨空间？今年不会改变，所以目前他们很难让任何人印象深刻到真正推动股价。

segments.en: enough to really move the stock. Well, I mean some of the language in here in the release from Jensen Wong this idea about an inflection point when it comes to AI and what he says that compute is now
segments.zh: 嗯，我是说，黄仁勋在新闻稿中的一些措辞，关于AI的转折点，以及他说计算现在……

segments.en: revenue he also says the Vera Rubin is now in full production so I understand maybe some of
segments.zh: 营收方面，他表示维拉·鲁宾现已全面投产，因此我理解可能有些
